disclosures: Per IL Security Deposit Return Act 765 ILCS 710, the landlord must provide an itemized statement of damages within 30 days.
The deposit must be returned within 45 days if no deductions, or within 30 days of providing the damage statement.
notes: Illinois has a 30-day deadline for the itemized statement and 45-day deadline for refund return.
Properties with 5+ units have stricter rules including interest requirements. Check local ordinances.
Paid receipts or estimates must accompany the itemized statement.
